13: A structured, hierarchy-based grievance redressal mechanism for transparent and timely resolution.
One Citizen. One Grievance. One System. End-to-End Resolution.
Outcome: Faster Resolution ✔ Transparency ✔ Accountability ✔ Citizen Satisfaction ✔ Better Governance ✔
Citizen raises a complaint through the portal/app. Provides location, category, description and photo evidence. → Complaint ID Generated & Acknowledgement Sent to Citizen
Grievance is routed to the respective Ward Corporator. Corporator reviews, validates and categorizes the issue. → Issue Validated & Forwarded to Department
Corporator assigns the issue to the concerned municipal department. Drainage issue → Engineering Department; Garbage issue → Sanitation Department. → Task Assigned & Department with Timeline
Department receives the task with defined timelines. Work is executed and updated in real time with proof (images/status). → Work Completed & Proof Uploaded

System monitors progress in real time. If delays occur, automatic escalation is triggered to higher authorities. Full visibility at Municipal Commissioner and Mayor level. → Escalation Ensures Timely Resolution & Accountability
